title: Here’s a look inside GlobalQuantAI, the AI n quant market analysis platform I’ve been building
author: dvysrm
selftext:
**So what exactly is GlobalQuantAI?**

GlobalQuantAI is a market analysis platform I built to make it easier to research global financial markets from one place.

It covers major **stock market indices, commodities and forex pairs**, and combines technical indicators, multi-timeframe analysis and AI-assisted market intelligence into an individual analysis page for each asset.

Instead of just showing the current price, each market gets its own analysis covering different timeframes.

The system looks at **1 minute, 5 minute, 15 minute, 1 hour and daily data** so you can compare the short-term market structure with the larger trend.

For example, a market can have a bullish short-term setup while the higher timeframes remain bearish. That difference is important because a simple single-timeframe signal can miss the bigger picture.

The platform currently combines indicators such as **RSI, MACD, EMA trends, Bollinger Bands, Stochastic and volume-based analysis** to generate a market signal and confidence estimate.

I also wanted the pages to be useful for people searching for things like:

**market forecast**  
**market analysis**  
**price prediction**  
**technical analysis**  
**AI market prediction**  
**stock market forecast**  
**forex analysis**  
**forex forecast**  
**commodity analysis**  
**gold price analysis**  
**crude oil forecast**  
**index prediction**

The goal isn't to pretend that an AI can magically predict the future.

It's more about taking a large amount of market data and technical information and turning it into something easier to interpret.

anyways check it out if you find the time for so: [https://globalquantai.com](https://globalquantai.com)

For example, you can use the platform to research:

**S&P 500 forecast and analysis**  
**Nasdaq 100 prediction and technical analysis**  
**DAX market analysis**  
**Nikkei 225 forecast**  
**Gold price analysis and prediction**  
**Silver market analysis**  
**Crude oil forecast**  
**EUR/USD forex analysis**  
**GBP/USD forecast**  
**USD/JPY technical analysis**

I built it because I personally got tired of having to jump between different charts, indicator pages, news sites and calculators just to form a view on one market.

Now I'm trying to turn that whole process into one platform.

The site is completely free to explore, so I’m posting this partly because I'd genuinely like feedback from people who actually trade or research markets.

**What would you want to see added to an AI market analysis platform like this?**

comments.author: Shoddy_Peanut7320
comments.body: Comparing short and higher timeframes on one page is useful, and I like that you say plainly it doesn't predict the future. Since the pages produce a signal and a confidence estimate, I'd show how past signals actually did: a running log of every signal with its timestamp and what price did over the next N bars, compared with a simple baseline, so users can see whether the confidence number means anything. One addition worth having is a scheduled-events panel (CPI, FOMC, earnings, OPEC) on each asset page, since signals around those behave differently, and Cymetica's EventTrader (event timing for macro releases and earnings) is one source for that.
